cells: First Administrator of the UT (1956, served 7 days)
Long-serving veteran MP from Lakshadweep (multiple terms from 1967 onward); prominent figure in the territory's post-Independence political history
Current (since June 2024) Lok Sabha MP for Lakshadweep (INC); son of P.M. Sayeed; previously MP 2009-2014, making him the youngest MP of the 15th Lok Sabha at the time of his first election
Current (2026) Administrator of Lakshadweep (additional charge, since December 2020); also Administrator of DNHⅅ associated with the significant 2021 administrative-reform controversy (Chapter 4)
Previous (2019-2024) Lok Sabha MP for Lakshadweep (NCP), whose brief disqualification and reinstatement over a criminal case became a notable national news episode during his tenure

blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: The Sayeed family (P.M. Sayeed and his son Muhammed Hamdullah Sayeed) represents a multi-generational political presence in Lakshadweep's Lok Sabha representation, a useful organising fact alongside the territory's small, single-constituency political landscape.

items: Lakshadweep: approx 32 sq km — India's SMALLEST UT/state by area; 36 islands, only ~10 inhabited.
Located in the Arabian Sea, ~220-440 km off Kochi, Kerala; capital: Kavaratti; largest island: Andrott.
Three groupings: Amindivi (north), Laccadive (centre/south), Minicoy (separate, southernmost).
India's ONLY entirely coral-atoll island territory (vs Andaman & Nicobar's volcanic/continental-shelf origin).
Local tradition credits Ubaidullah with introducing Islam; near-total Islamic conversion followed over centuries.
Arakkal family of Cannanore (Kerala's only Muslim royal dynasty) historically held authority over parts of the islands.
UT formed 1 November 1956 as 'Laccadive, Minicoy and Amindivi Islands'; renamed 'Lakshadweep' in 1973.
No Legislative Assembly; Administrator: Praful Khoda Patel (additional charge, since Dec 2020; also DNH&DD Administrator).
1 Lok Sabha seat (ST-reserved); current MP: Muhammed Hamdullah Sayeed (INC, since June 2024).
Judiciary under the Kerala High Court.
2021 LDAR/regulatory reforms controversy: land development, panchayat rules, preventive detention, beef ban proposals.
PM Modi's January 2024 visit + India-Maldives diplomatic row triggered a major tourism-interest surge.
Coconut (copra, coir) and pole-and-line tuna fishing are the traditional economic mainstays.
Population (2011): approx 64,473 — India's smallest by population; ~96-97% Muslim — highest share of any Indian state/UT.
Malayalam = majority language (most islands); Mahl (Dhivehi-related) = Minicoy's distinct language.
Matrilineal social traditions historically prevalent, shared with parts of Kerala.
Coral reefs are structurally inseparable from the islands' existence; acute climate-change/sea-level-rise vulnerability.
Pitti Island Bird Sanctuary = key protected seabird site; KLI Submarine Optical Fibre Cable brought broadband in the early 2020s.
Revise this chapter last — it consolidates every numeric/name/date fact from Chapters 1-10 in one place for rapid recall.
The two most distinctive Lakshadweep superlatives to never confuse: SMALLEST UT by area/population (Lakshadweep) vs LARGEST UT by area (Ladakh, covered in the companion volume).
Always verify current officeholders (Administrator, MP) closer to your exam date, since these can change.
